text:
Sam P: kickoff for Marigold trial — quick sync on integration handoff. Timeline still W2 of next month. Owners and open deps below.
Irene C: thanks. can we lock acceptance criteria? who's owning the connector CR?
Devon S: I'll own connector CR (DEV). ETA code review EOW. I need their API spec + staging credentials.
Maya R: I'll own QA validation. Need sample payloads and schema diffs. Can someone add to the shared doc? https://redwood.app/s/marigold-poc
Sam P: added doc. Acceptance criteria (draft):
- end-to-end inference within 400ms median
- <=2% failure rate on 10k test requests
- RBAC & audit logging verified
- Data flow uses VPC egress via our peering
Irene C: looks good. add 'graceful fallback' to smaller model if capacity exceeded.
Devon S: FYI connector CR depends on eng-runtime change to header auth (ENG-1024). That change is targeted 2024-03-21. If that slips, we fallback to API-token proxy.
Maya R: QA checklist: run 3 runs of peak load, validate latency histograms, confirm logs, and run integration smoke. Will need credentials and test dataset.
Sam P: owners: Devon (connector), Maya (QA), Irene (security review), Sam (PM). Open deps: Marigold staging creds (sales), ENG-1024 runtime header auth, Network peering ticket (INFRA-333).
Oliver (sales): pinging Marigold for staging creds. I can escalate.
QA-bot: scheduled test run on staging for 2024-03-18 09:00 UTC — will post results.
Devon S: code review opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connector/pull/987 — reviewers @Lucy @Mike. CR notes: adds header auth toggle.
Lucy: reviewing now. small nits but overall ok.
Sam P: if CR merged + ENG-1024 on time we aim for canary on staging 2024-03-22. If not, plan B: token-proxy patch (Devon) — 2024-03-24.
Irene C: security signoff checklist added to doc.
Oliver (sales): got creds from Marigold — staging username shared privately. I'll DM Devon and Maya.
Sam P: thanks — next async update Friday EOD. If blockers pop, call out in this thread. :thumbsup:
